importance.text: This chapter explains the behavior of waves and their applications. It covers transverse and longitudinal waves, helping us understand different types of wave motion. The displacement relation in progressive waves and the formula for the speed of a traveling wave are essential for analyzing wave properties. Concepts like the principle of superposition, reflection of waves, and beats provide insights into wave interactions, which are vital in understanding sound, light, and various technologies.
